value.behaviour: Styles the page tab bar: a horizontally scrollable row of tabs with an add button and active-tab controls, using the editor's CSS variables.
rules: All rules are nested under `.excalidraw .page-tab-bar`; the bar is `display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; max-width: 50vw; overflow-x: auto; pointer-events: var(--ui-pointerEvents);` with the island look (`background-color: var(--island-bg-color); border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-island); padding: 0.25rem;`).

`.page-tab-bar__tab` is a borderless button with `color: var(--text-primary-color)`, `border-radius: var(--border-radius-md)`, `padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem`, `white-space: nowrap`, `font-size: 0.875rem`; `&:hover` uses `background-color: var(--button-hover-bg)`; `&--active` uses `background-color: var(--color-surface-primary-container)` and `font-weight: 600`.

`.page-tab-bar__rename-input` is `width: 8rem` with `font: inherit`; `.page-tab-bar__icon-button` is a 2rem square borderless button with a 1rem svg and the same hover rule; `&:disabled` has `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed`.

style_from.reason: Footer-hosted SCSS module shape and pointer-events variable.

value.behaviour: Renders one tab per visible page and the create, inline rename, move and delete controls, dispatching the page actions through the action manager.
rules: Props: `{ appState: UIAppState; actionManager: ActionManager }`; reads `useApp()` for `app.scene`; computes `pages = getVisiblePages(appState.pages)`; `isEditable = !appState.viewModeEnabled`.

Markup: `<div className="page-tab-bar" data-testid="page-tab-bar">` containing `<div role="tablist" aria-label={t("pages.tabBar")}>` with one `<button type="button" role="tab">` per page: `className` `page-tab-bar__tab` plus `page-tab-bar__tab--active` when `page.id === appState.activePageId`, `aria-selected` true/false accordingly, `data-testid={`page-tab-${page.id}`}`, text = page name, `onClick` executes `actionSwitchPage` with value `page.id`.

When `isEditable`: double-clicking a tab, or clicking the rename button, sets local `renamingPageId`; that tab is replaced by `<input className="page-tab-bar__rename-input" aria-label={t("pages.renameInput")} data-testid="page-rename-input" autoFocus defaultValue={page.name}>`; Enter or blur commits via `actionRenamePage` with `{ pageId, name: input.value }` (the action ignores an empty trimmed name, so the old name stays) and clears `renamingPageId`; Escape clears it without committing; key events stop propagation so editor shortcuts do not fire.

When `isEditable`, after the tablist: icon buttons (class `page-tab-bar__icon-button`, each with `aria-label` and `title` from `t`) for the active page: rename (`data-testid="page-rename"`), move left (`page-move-left`, disabled when the active page is first, value `{ pageId, direction: -1 }`), move right (`page-move-right`, disabled when last, direction 1), delete (`page-delete`, disabled when `pages.length <= 1`), and the add button (`page-add`, `PlusIcon`, executes `actionCreatePage`).

Delete: when the active page has any non-deleted element in `app.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()`, set local `pendingDeletePageId` and render `<ConfirmDialog title={t("pages.deleteConfirmTitle")} onConfirm={...} onCancel={...}>` with `t("pages.deleteConfirm", { name })`; confirm executes `actionDeletePage` with the page id and clears the state; an empty page is deleted without the dialog.
Imports `./PageTabBar.scss`; the component is the default export and sets `PageTabBar.displayName = "PageTabBar"`.

style_from.reason: Footer component shape, clsx usage and SCSS import.

uses.reason: Props passed into footer children (UIAppState, ActionManager).

value.behaviour: Mounts the page tab bar in the footer, hidden in zen mode.
rules: Renders `<PageTabBar appState={appState} actionManager={actionManager} />` right before `<FooterCenterTunnel.Out />` when `defaultUIEnabled && !appState.zenModeEnabled`; view mode still renders it (the bar itself shows switching only).

sites.rule: Render the tab bar under the condition in the rules.
